category: map tiles (Stamen styles hosted by Stadia Maps)

free_tier.stated: Creating the Stadia Maps account needs no credit card
free_tier.notes: the 200,000-tile figure is from the Stamen page's text of 2023 and the allowance is the Stadia Maps Free plan's, whose current credit terms sit on the Stadia Maps pricing page; the keyless maps.stamen.com tile service ended when its redirects stopped on October 31, 2023

per_object_cap.stated: in the legacy archive each tile is one object at s3://{bucket}{prefix}/{z}/{x}/{y}.{extension}; the archive is an outdated snapshot that does not cover the whole globe at every zoom level

egress.terms: the legacy S3 buckets are requester-pays: AWS charges the downloader for requests and bandwidth and does not charge Stamen

interface_detail: HTTPS XYZ tile URLs at tiles.stadiamaps.com/tiles/stamen_toner/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png (stamen_terrain and stamen_watercolor too, the latter a .jpg) with domain authentication or an api_key parameter; the original tiles are in requester-pays S3 buckets tile.stamen.com and long-term.cache.maps.stamen.com
tooling: Leaflet, MapLibre, OpenLayers and any XYZ tile client; the AWS CLI or an SDK with requester-pays enabled for the legacy buckets
chaining: the Stamen styles spend the same Stadia Maps account and free tile allowance as any other Stadia Maps tile; the original keyless maps.stamen.com service ended on October 31, 2023, so a new project signs up with Stadia Maps or reads the legacy archive from requester-pays S3 buckets

limits.value: under 200,000 tiles a month free; plans from $20/month above that or
unverified: the Stamen pages state no rate limit; the Stadia Maps plan governs it

binding_note: no rate limit is stated on the Stamen pages, so the 200,000-tile monthly figure is the first limit met

identity_cost.detail: a Stadia Maps account, which the migration guide says needs no credit card to create; the legacy S3 archive needs an AWS account that pays the request and bandwidth charges

reliability_note: the keyless maps.stamen.com tile service ended on October 31, 2023 and its redirects no longer work; the legacy archive is outdated and incomplete, provided to be accessed and used at the user's own risk
confidence_note: the Stamen home page and its Stadia Maps partnership page, the Stadia Maps Stamen page and the migration guide were quoted on 2026-11-02; the 200,000-tile figure is dated 2023 and may differ from the current Stadia Maps credit terms. No account was opened and no legacy tile was downloaded.
